description: Defines a wrapper interface (CurlWrapsImpl) and a singleton class (CurlWraps) for handling curl multi interface operations, such as performing actions, reading info, and polling, primarily used for mocking in tests.

classes.name: CurlWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface class for curl multi operations; provides virtual methods for perform, info read, and poll.

classes.name: CurlWraps
classes.description: Singleton class offering static methods to interact with curl multi APIs, delegating to an implementation that can be swapped for testing.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::curl_multi_info_read
methods.description: Reads informational messages from the multi-handle.

methods.name: CurlWraps::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by CurlWraps.

methods.name: CurlWraps::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CurlWraps.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_perform
methods.description: Static method calling the underlying implementation's perform.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_info_read
methods.description: Static method calling the underlying implementation's info read.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_poll
methods.description: Static method calling the underlying implementation's poll.
